name: Pooled on-demand service marketplace
goal: Prove one complete customer-to-provider transaction including fulfillment, settlement and reputation feedback.
steps: provider discovers the paid order in the public pool
provider starts and finishes the service
provider settlement becomes available balance and ledger history
review becomes visible on the provider public profile

acceptance.providerValueFlow: wallet delta equals order.player_amount and PROVIDER_INCOME ledger exists
acceptance.reputationFlow: submitted review is visible in the provider public profile
acceptance.orderEvidence: append-only OrderEvent.to_status values cover the expected state path in order
acceptance.supplyStorefront: provider has non-placeholder profile, verified skills and multiple active offerings
